title: Can the Police Search Your Car?
selection_note: Real-footage (Veritasium-style) b-roll PLAN + per-span visual binding. No media copied, nothing rendered. Factory candidates are addressed by subtype + query; the actual clip FILE for each candidate is chosen during the mandatory visual-QC pass (see footage_qc_checklist.v001.md). Folder labels are NOT trusted -- every first frame is eyeballed before it enters the render. UPDATE (M10 remediation): every one of the 22 spans (SPN-0001..0022 <-> scenes S001..S022) is now explicitly bound to its three layers -- Codex AI stills (codex_stills), factory footage (factory_candidates) and Remotion meaning-graphics (remotion_motion_surfaces) -- and an image_manifest records exactly which S0NN stills are REQUIRED, which EXIST on disk and which are MISSING, so no cut can fall back to a black/empty frame.

conventions.kind_preference: video (b-roll cutaways ~2.2s); image only as still fallback
conventions.three_layer_rule: factory b-roll (real) + AI hero/symbol (Codex codex_stills) + Remotion meaning graphics (BrightLine/CarCutaway/timeline). Every span binds all three so no layer is overworked and no cut is left visual-less. See visual_intent per span.
conventions.span_to_scene: SPN-000N maps 1:1 to scene S0NN (SPN-0001->S001 ... SPN-0022->S022). codex_stills S0NN ids reference generated_images/codex_v001/PD-2026-032-S0NN-IMG-001.png.

image_manifest.note: Reconciles the AI-still layer so no cut is left without a visual (black/empty-frame prevention, M10). REQUIRED = every S0NN still bound to a scene cut in scene_plan.v001.json (required_assets COD-S0NN) and named in script.annotated.v001.json visual_intent. EXISTS = PNGs actually present in the stills_dir right now (verified by directory listing + non-zero byte size). MISSING = REQUIRED minus EXISTS = the exact list Codex must still generate.
image_manifest.reconciliation_of_40_vs_29: The ai_prompts spec calls for 40 stills (S001..S040). Of those, 33 are actually BOUND to a scene cut (REQUIRED); the other 7 are extra angle/framing variants not tied to a specific cut. The EP32 remediation ledger (M10) was written when only 29 stills existed on disk; since then Codex generated the remainder. A live listing now shows all 40 PNGs (S001..S040) present with real (multi-MB) byte sizes. Therefore all 33 REQUIRED stills exist and MISSING = 0. The 40-vs-29 gap is closed; black-frame risk from absent stills is eliminated.
image_manifest.black_frame_risk: eliminated -- every REQUIRED still exists on disk; every span also carries factory footage + Remotion graphics as independent fallback layers (three_layer_rule).

image_manifest.integrity_check: required_count(33) + present_optional_variant count(7) = 40 = specified_count and exists_on_disk_count; required_exists_count(33) == required_count(33); missing_count(0) == required_count - required_exists_count. Internally consistent and matches disk.

True driveway/porch curtilage plate -- no driveway/porch subtype exists on the shelf; AI stills S018/S036 + front_door_house + white_picket_fence + suburban_house_exterior_night are the substitutes.
gap_routing: These beats are NOT on the factory shelf (verified: queries for motorcycle/handcuffs/tarp/glovebox/bottle/driveway/rental all return 0 despite the inventory doc implying otherwise). They are routed to Codex AI stills (all already generated -- see image_manifest.required_stills; no real-person likeness, no real plates -- invariant 11) or to Remotion motifs (CarCutaway, BrightLine, CarKeyLock, RegionHighlightMap). Do NOT substitute a mislabeled shelf clip to fake these.

diversity_tally.scope: factory b-roll (real footage) layer only; AI stills and Remotion graphics are separate layers and are not counted here.
diversity_tally.planned_distinct_file_ratio_note: Each candidate_clips unit = one UNIQUE shelf file pulled fresh during QC; distinct files == total placements, so file-level distinct/total = 1.00 >= 0.40 gate.
diversity_tally.cross_scene_reuse_note: Where a subtype spans multiple scenes (e.g. police_car_lights_night, suburban_house_exterior_night, car_light_trails_long_exposure), QC MUST pull visually distinct framings/angles for each scene -- distinct FILES, not the same file recut. Enforces footage_diversity 'no repeats'.
